title: Jyn Erso
subtitle: Resisting Oppression
text: Action [Exhaust]: Attack with a unit. The defender gets -1/-0 for this attack.
deployBox: While a friendly unit is attacking, the defender gets -1/-0.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 6 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules:
If you use Jyn’s leader ability, you must attack with a unit, if able. Units must be ready in order to attack.
(ERRATA) Templating update: “Defender” becomes “defending unit”.
